svg.title: Beyond mise
svg.desc: Stacked area chart of cumulative GitHub stars since January 2025 for jdx's tools other than mise: 9k stars in total, about 1.58k a year earlier. mr boxington 626, aube 2053, fnox 2322, hk 1289, pitchfork 698, usage 1064, +6 more 947.
